title: PLAYER 2 TAKING OVER THE RAID DOES NOT RUN THE RAID EVENTS AGAIN
why: Cloud robustness hunt. A linked player 2 window plans no raid events: it keeps the host events from the world word. When the host window goes and player 2 picks up the raid (his ruling), that window planned the events for the first time from the same seed, and every planned event whose time had passed launched again, so an event the host had already run (its warning, its ring, its debris, its bounty or convoy) came a second time. Proven in headless Chromium on v27.30 (CAREER seed 23): orbital debris planned at 185 s, ran and ended; at 286 s the plan was cleared and the raid marked as taken over, as player 2 holds it, and 2 s later ORBITAL DEBRIS was in its warning again. Now a window that took over marks the planned events already due as done when it first plans, and runs only the ones still to come. A raid that never had a host is unchanged.
now: When player 1 leaves mid-raid and player 2 carries on, a raid event that already happened does not happen again.

edits.replacement: if(!E.plan){ if(t<3) return; evPlan(E); if(G.netWasJoin){ for(i=0;i<E.plan.length;i++) if(t>=E.plan[i].at) E.plan[i].on=1; } }   // v27.xx (cloud-robust-takeover-events), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: a window that took the raid over does not run again the events the host already ran
